message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and instead of the usual scramble, I felt a weird sense of calm. I had my trusty flashlight and a couple of power banks ready to go, while my kids enjoyed our lanterns like they were camping in the living room. It was such a relief to finally be the prepared one for once, instead of fumbling around in the dark. Who knew being ready could feel so good? Have you ever had a moment like that?
